rows.question: 階梯傳動軸現在可用的有幾件？
rows.sql:
SELECT v.available AS 可用庫存
FROM v_part_stock v
WHERE v.name = '階梯傳動軸'
LIMIT 1

rows.question: 二廠成品倉放了哪些零件？各多少件？
rows.sql:
SELECT p.name AS 品名, SUM(s.qty) AS 數量
FROM stock s
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = s.part_id
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
WHERE w.name = '二廠成品倉'
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY 數量 DESC
LIMIT 50

rows.question: 目前有哪些不良品？數量和原因是什麼？
rows.sql:
SELECT p.name AS 品名, s.lot_no AS 批號, s.qty AS 數量, s.note AS 原因
FROM stock s
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = s.part_id
WHERE s.status = '不良'
ORDER BY s.qty DESC

rows.question: 晨峰自動化還有哪些訂單沒出完貨？
rows.sql:
SELECT o.so_no AS 訂單號, o.line_no AS 項次, o.customer AS 客戶, p.name AS 品名, o.qty - o.qty_shipped AS 未出貨, o.due_on AS 交期
FROM sales_orders o
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = o.part_id
WHERE o.customer = '晨峰自動化' AND o.status != '已出貨'
ORDER BY o.due_on

rows.question: 10 月 10 日以前到期、還沒出完貨的訂單有哪些？
rows.sql:
SELECT o.so_no AS 訂單號, o.line_no AS 項次, o.customer AS 客戶, p.name AS 品名, o.qty - o.qty_shipped AS 未出貨, o.due_on AS 交期
FROM sales_orders o
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = o.part_id
WHERE o.status != '已出貨' AND o.due_on <= '2026-10-10'
ORDER BY o.due_on

rows.question: 哪些訂單的未出貨數量超過該零件目前的可用庫存？
rows.sql:
SELECT o.so_no AS 訂單號, o.line_no AS 項次, o.customer AS 客戶, p.name AS 品名, o.qty - o.qty_shipped AS 未出貨數量, v.available AS 可用庫存
FROM sales_orders o
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = o.part_id
JOIN v_part_stock v ON v.part_id = p.part_id
WHERE o.qty - o.qty_shipped > v.available
ORDER BY 未出貨數量 DESC

rows.question: 各零件未出貨訂單的需求量加總是多少？
rows.sql:
SELECT p.name AS 品名, SUM(o.qty - o.qty_shipped) AS 未出貨總需求量
FROM sales_orders o
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = o.part_id
WHERE o.status != '已出貨'
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY 未出貨總需求量 DESC

rows.question: 哪個零件的標準成本最高？
rows.sql:
SELECT name AS 品名, std_cost_twd AS 標準成本
FROM parts
ORDER BY std_cost_twd DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: 待檢的庫存有哪些？
rows.sql:
SELECT p.name AS 品名, w.name AS 倉庫, s.lot_no AS 批號, s.qty AS 數量, s.status AS 狀態, s.note AS 備註
FROM stock s
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = s.part_id
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
WHERE s.status = '待檢'
ORDER BY s.qty DESC

rows.question: 機密等級為「機密」的零件，庫存總共有幾件？
rows.sql:
SELECT SUM(s.qty) AS 庫存總數
FROM stock s
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = s.part_id
WHERE p.confidentiality = '機密'
GROUP BY p.part_id

rows.question: T 型槽螺帽有哪些批號？各放在哪個儲位？
rows.sql:
SELECT s.lot_no AS 批號, s.bin AS 儲位
FROM stock s
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = s.part_id
WHERE p.name = 'T 型槽螺帽'
ORDER BY s.lot_no

rows.question: 九月底盤點調整了哪些零件？差多少？
rows.sql:
SELECT p.name AS 品名, SUM(m.qty) AS 差額
FROM stock_moves m
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = m.part_id
WHERE m.move_type = '盤點調整'
AND m.moved_on = '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY 差額 DESC

rows.question: 八、九月總共報廢了幾件？
rows.sql:
SELECT -SUM(m.qty) AS 報廢數量
FROM stock_moves m
WHERE m.move_type = '報廢'
  AND m.moved_on BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY m.part_id
ORDER BY 報廢數量 DESC

rows.question: VMC-01 這台機台有哪些還沒完工的工單？
rows.sql:
SELECT w.wo_no AS 工單號, p.name AS 品名, w.qty_planned - w.qty_done AS 未完工數量, w.status AS 狀態, w.due_on AS 預計完工日, w.priority AS 優先
FROM work_orders w
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = w.part_id
JOIN schedule_ops s ON s.wo_no = w.wo_no AND s.machine_id = 'VMC-01'
WHERE w.status != '已完工'
ORDER BY w.due_on

rows.question: 每個客戶的訂購數量總共是多少？
rows.sql:
SELECT customer AS 客戶, SUM(qty) AS 總訂購數量
FROM sales_orders
GROUP BY customer
ORDER BY 總訂購數量 DESC

rows.question: 步進馬達安裝板保留的庫存是保留給哪張訂單？
rows.sql:
SELECT s.note AS 備註
FROM stock s
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = s.part_id
WHERE p.name = '步進馬達安裝板' AND s.status = '保留'
LIMIT 1

rows.question: 一廠各倉庫目前的庫存總數是多少？
rows.sql:
SELECT w.name AS 倉庫, SUM(s.qty) AS 庫存總數
FROM stock s
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
WHERE w.site = '一廠'
GROUP BY w.name
ORDER BY 庫存總數 DESC

rows.question: 哪些工單正在生產中或委外處理中？預計何時完工？
rows.sql:
SELECT w.wo_no AS 工單號, p.name AS 品名, w.status AS 狀態, w.due_on AS 預計完工日, w.priority AS 優先
FROM work_orders w
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = w.part_id
WHERE w.status IN ('生產中', '委外處理中')
ORDER BY w.due_on

rows.question: 總庫存最多的前三個零件是哪些？
rows.sql:
SELECT p.name AS 品名, SUM(s.qty) AS 總庫存
FROM stock s
JOIN parts p ON p.part_id = s.part_id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY 總庫存 DESC
LIMIT 3

rows.question: 立式軸承座的可用庫存扣掉所有未出貨訂單後還剩多少？
rows.sql:
SELECT p.name AS 品名, v.available AS 可用庫存, SUM(o.qty - o.qty_shipped) AS 未出貨訂單數量, v.available - SUM(o.qty - o.qty_shipped) AS 剩餘可用庫存
FROM v_part_stock v
JOIN parts p ON v.part_id = p.part_id
LEFT JOIN sales_orders o ON p.part_id = o.part_id AND o.status != '已出貨'
WHERE p.name = '立式軸承座'
GROUP BY v.available, p.name
ORDER BY 剩餘可用庫存 DESC
